g.text: 3 mOhm nominal trips: discharge 1.93 A / 128 ms; short 6.83 A / 280 us; charge 6.67 A / 32 ms.

g.desc: 3 mOhm nominal trips: discharge 1.93 A / 128 ms; short 6.83 A / 280 us; charge 6.67 A / 32 ms.

g.text: 4.590 V overcharge / 512 ms; 2.500 V overdischarge / 64 ms. Delays and thresholds are nominal.

g.desc: 4.590 V overcharge / 512 ms; 2.500 V overdischarge / 64 ms. Delays and thresholds are nominal.

g.text: Current thresholds are coupled by this suffix; charger current remains programmed separately.

g.desc: Current thresholds are coupled by this suffix; charger current remains programmed separately.

g.text: Raw parallel-cell bus -> shunt -> charge FET -> discharge FET -> BQ25186 BAT. All pack current uses this path.

g.desc: Raw parallel-cell bus -> shunt -> charge FET -> discharge FET -> BQ25186 BAT. All pack current uses this path.

g.text: LAYOUT: Kelvin sense R54 at its pads; keep U27/C44/R55 close. Common drains must not connect to another rail.

g.desc: LAYOUT: Kelvin sense R54 at its pads; keep U27/C44/R55 close. Common drains must not connect to another rail.

g.text: PS has an explicit no-connect; TH ties to filtered VSS. No optional PS/TH features enabled.

g.desc: PS has an explicit no-connect; TH ties to filtered VSS. No optional PS/TH features enabled.

g.text: Fault recovery: USB charger connection may be needed after cell connection, undervoltage or overload.
